title: Behavior Random Sitting
description: Allows the mob to randomly sit for a duration.

priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

cooldown.description: Minimum time in ticks between sitting.

min_sit_time.description: Minimum time in seconds to sit.

start_chance.description: Probability per tick of starting to sit.

stop_chance.description: Probability per tick of stopping sitting.
